audit.whatIsWrong: Page claims Chaos Storm has a 'silence' that shuts off Solar Snare and Overwhelm — Viktor's R has no silence; Riot text says it interrupts enemy channels. 'Death Ray' used for E, real name is Hextech Ray. Enemy repeatedly called 'he' — Mel is she/her.
audit.why: Kit files are authoritative on names and mechanics.
audit.corrected: Silence claims replaced with the real mechanic (moving zone Rebuttal cannot reflect); Hextech Ray restored; pronouns corrected across 20 flagged fields.

audit.why: Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1, 26s max — the matchup's defining window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interactions: Solar Snare can cancel your Arcane Storm channel-follow; Rebuttal absorbs/reflects your burst; Rebuttal terrain cuts retreat.
audit.why: From _missing file. Rebuttal bait now explicit in dosFull; Overwhelm execute now in dontsFull[2].d.
audit.corrected: Folded into edits where a field existed; terrain-cuts-retreat noted only (no clean slot at length).

edits.before: After a rocky level 1 you take over here: Death Ray out-ranges her Radiant Volley and, crucially, is a persistent beam she cannot cleanly Rebuttal-reflect the way she parries single projectiles. edits.before: Your level 6 is strong because Chaos Storm's damage is a moving zone, not a single projectile she can Rebuttal, and its silence shuts off her Solar Snare root and Overwhelm execute. Keep trading through your range advantage, but track her R threshold since Overwhelm executes low targets — don't dip below it carelessly.

Keep trading through your range advantage, but track her R threshold since Overwhelm executes low targets — don't dip below it carelessly.
